source.name: revolutionsoccer.net: New England Revolution welcome Gillette as official jersey sponsor in expanded multi-year partnership
source.quote: an expanded multi-year partnership that welcomes the Boston-based men’s grooming brand as the official front-of-jersey sponsor
source.note: The club's announcement (February 11, 2025) makes Gillette the front-of-jersey sponsor; Sports Business Journal reports the partnership runs through the 2031 MLS season, and FOR SOCCER's 2026 MLS Jersey Sponsors list (https://www.forsoccer.com/insight/2026-mls-jersey-sponsors/) shows Gillette as the Revolution's 2026 jersey partner.

source.name: FOR SOCCER: 2026 MLS Jersey Sponsors
source.quote: media partner Apple, once again, will be on the left sleeve of every jersey
source.note: The same page's sleeve table lists Apple TV as the Revolution's left sleeve with no right-sleeve partner. SportsLogos.Net (2026-03-02, https://news.sportslogos.net/2026/03/02/mls-to-allow-back-of-jersey-ads-starting-after-2026-all-star-break/soccer/) corroborates: 'All 30 MLS clubs feature the Apple TV+ logo on the left sleeve patch as part of a league-wide deal.'

summary: Gillette, the Boston-based grooming brand, is on the front of the Revolution's shirt in an expanded multi-year partnership announced in February 2025; the league-wide Apple TV+ patch is on the left sleeve, and FOR SOCCER's 2026 list shows no right-sleeve partner for the club. All MLS clubs wear Adidas.
